## Accredited Certification Scopes
1. **ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management Systems - QMS):** Standardized operational workflows, risk-based auditing, zero-defect quality control systems, customer satisfaction loops.
2. **ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management Systems - EMS):** Ecological safeguards, hazardous waste monitoring, industrial effluent control, emissions management, energy sustainability.
3. **ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety - OH&S):** Workplace hazard prevention, industrial hygiene, emergency preparedness, machinery guarding, employee wellness.
4. **C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism):** US Customs & Border Protection supply chain security certification, 7-point container inspections, physical facility perimeter audits, partner background verification.
5. **Technical Audits & Factory Capability Reviews:** Machinery calibration checks, inline defect mapping, quality control laboratory scrutiny, factory production capacity verification.
6. **FSNS & SQF Hygiene Standards:** Food packaging sanitation, HACCP alignment, contamination barrier audits.
7. **ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Competence:** Calibration uncertainty, testing methodology scrutiny, laboratory environmental control validation.
8. **CE Marking Conformity Directives:** European market conformity assessments and technical construction file reviews.

## Corporate Boundaries
ARG REGISTRARS PAKISTAN (argregistrars.com) is an independent corporate auditing and ISO certification registrar firm. It operates entirely separate from consumer brands or retail commerce.
